name: Taszo-son-Clutio

features.Resolved: After Taszo spends focus to resist a character’s influence, that character loses 1 focus.
features.Broken Arm: Taszo can only use one hand.

Strike Sidesword.Description: Attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 3) keen damage.

Strike Shortbow.Description: When an ally within 5 feet of Taszo fails a test, Taszo adds an Opportunity to the test result.

Tactics: Taszo seeks to be helpful, though he is unaccustomed to fighting with his broken arm. He assists whoever is most threatened, spending his focus on A Friend in Need to aid allies in tough situations.
